fields.name: SYNCRDY
fields.text: Set when STATUS.SYNCBUSY falls from 1 to 0, except after an enable or software reset, and requests an interrupt if SYNCRDY is enabled; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: WINMON
fields.text: Set on the GCLK_ADC cycle after the window condition matches, and requests an interrupt if WINMON is enabled; cleared by writing 1 or by reading RESULT, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVERRUN
fields.text: Set when RESULT is overwritten before the CPU has read the previous value, and requests an interrupt if OVERRUN is enabled; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: RESRDY
fields.text: Goes to 1 once a finished conversion result can be read, requesting an interrupt if RESRDY is enabled; cleared by writing 1 or by reading RESULT, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: SYNCBUSY
fields.text: Reads 1 while registers are being synchronized between clock domains, 0 once that is done.

fields.name: RESULT
fields.text: Conversion result, up to 16 bits. A single-ended conversion without averaging gives 12 bits: in [11:0] when right-adjusted, or with CTRLB.LEFTADJ set the high byte in [15:8] and the low 4 bits in [7:4], so an 8-bit result can be read from the high byte alone. With oversampling the result sits in [15:0], depending on AVGCTRL.

fields.name: WINLT
fields.text: Lower threshold of the window monitor, when it is enabled.

fields.name: WINUT
fields.text: Upper threshold of the window monitor, when it is enabled.

fields.name: GAINCORR
fields.text: Gain error correction applied to the result before it is stored, when CTRLB.CORREN is 1; a fixed-point value of 1 integer bit and 11 fraction bits, from 0.10000000000 to 1.11111111111 binary, so 1/2 <= GAINCORR < 2.

fields.name: OFFSETCORR
fields.text: Offset error correction applied to the result before it is stored, when CTRLB.CORREN is 1; two's complement.

fields.name: BIAS_CAL
fields.text: Bias calibration from production test; software copies it unchanged from the NVM software calibration area to reach the specified accuracy.

fields.name: LINEARITY_CAL
fields.text: Linearity calibration from production test; software copies it unchanged from the NVM software calibration area to reach the specified accuracy.

fields.name: DBGRUN
fields.text: Chooses whether the ADC keeps running in debug mode. Changeable only with the ADC disabled, and to be written only with no conversion under way.

values.text: ADC keeps working in debug mode.

fields.name: LPMUX
fields.text: Selects high-resistance, lower-power analog input muxes. Not synchronized.

values.text: Low-resistance muxes that draw more power at low supply, for example when driven by the voltage doubler.
High-resistance muxes that draw less power at low supply, for example with the voltage doubler off.

fields.name: RUNSTDBY
fields.text: Chooses whether the comparators keep working in standby sleep mode. Not synchronized.

values.text: Comparator pair keeps working in sleep.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Turns the AC on or off; the written value reads back at once while STATUS.SYNCBUSY is set, and SYNCBUSY clears when the change has taken effect.

values.text: AC on; each comparator also needs its own COMPCTRLn.ENABLE.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: Writing 1 returns every AC register to its reset value and disables the AC; it overrides any other write in the same operation, and both SWRST and STATUS.SYNCBUSY clear once the synchronized reset is done. Writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: STARTx
fields.text: Writing 1 to bit x starts one single-shot comparison on comparator x when COMPCTRLx.SINGLE and COMPCTRLx.ENABLE are both 1; otherwise, or if the comparator is absent, nothing happens. Writing 0 does nothing; reads 0.

fields.name: COMPEIx
fields.text: Makes any incoming event start a comparison on comparator x; with several events connected, any of them triggers it and the source cannot be told apart.

values.text: Events do not start a comparison.
Any incoming event starts a comparison.

fields.name: WINEO0
fields.text: Lets the window function generate a peripheral event.

fields.name: COMPEOx
fields.text: Lets the output of comparator x generate a peripheral event.

fields.name: WIN0
fields.text: Reads the window interrupt enable; writing 1 disables that interrupt, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: COMPx
fields.text: Reads the comparator x interrupt enable; writing 1 disables that interrupt, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: WIN0
fields.text: Reads the window interrupt enable; writing 1 enables that interrupt, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: COMPx
fields.text: Reads the comparator x interrupt enable; writing 1 enables that interrupt, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: WIN0
fields.text: Set as chosen by WINCTRL.WINTSEL0, and requests an interrupt if the window interrupt is enabled; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: COMPx
fields.text: Comparator x interrupt flag, set as chosen by COMPCTRLx.INTSEL, requesting an interrupt if enabled; reads 0 for an absent comparator. Writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: WSTATE0
fields.text: Where the signal is relative to window 0, when window mode is on (reads 0 if window 0 is absent): 0x0 above; 0x1 inside; 0x2 below; 0x3 reserved.

fields.name: STATEx
fields.text: Current output of comparator x; valid only while STATUSB.READYx is 1.

fields.name: SYNCBUSY
fields.text: Reads 1 while registers are being synchronized between clock domains, 0 once that is done.

fields.name: READYx
fields.text: Reads 1 when the output of comparator x is ready, 0 when it is not; always 0 for an absent comparator.

registers.name: STATUSC
registers.title: Status C
notes: Holds the same states as STATUSA, and reading it also starts a comparison on every comparator set for single-shot mode. The read stalls until every enabled comparator has its output ready; a comparator already mid-comparison finishes that one and does not start another.

fields.name: WSTATE0
fields.text: Where the signal is relative to window 0, when window mode is on (reads 0 if window 0 is absent): 0x0 above; 0x1 inside; 0x2 below; 0x3 reserved.

fields.name: STATEx
fields.text: Current output of comparator x; valid only while STATUSB.READYx is 1, and 0 for an absent comparator.

fields.name: WINTSEL0
fields.text: When window 0 raises its interrupt: 0x0 signal above the window; 0x1 inside; 0x2 below; 0x3 outside.

fields.name: WEN0
fields.text: Turns on window mode for comparators 0 and 1.

values.text: Window mode off for comparators 0 and 1.
Window mode on for comparators 0 and 1.

fields.name: FLEN
fields.text: Output filter of comparator n: 0x0 none; 0x1 majority of 3; 0x2 majority of 5; 0x3-0x7 reserved. Writable only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0; not synchronized.

fields.name: HYST
fields.text: Turns on hysteresis for comparator n, available only in continuous mode (SINGLE = 0). Writable only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0; not synchronized.

fields.name: OUT
fields.text: What reaches the COMPn I/O pin: 0x0 nothing; 0x1 the asynchronous output; 0x2 the synchronous, filtered output; 0x3 reserved. Writable only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0; not synchronized.

values.name: OFF
values.text: COMPn I/O pin not driven by COMPn.

values.name: ASYNC
values.text: Asynchronous COMPn output on the COMPn I/O pin.

values.name: SYNC
values.text: Synchronous, filtered COMPn output on the COMPn I/O pin.

fields.name: SWAP
fields.text: Exchanges the two inputs of comparator n and inverts its output, usable to cancel offset. Writable only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0; not synchronized.

values.text: MUXPOS to the positive input, MUXNEG to the negative.
MUXNEG to the positive input, MUXPOS to the negative.

fields.name: MUXPOS
fields.text: Positive input of comparator n: 0x0 to 0x3 select I/O pins 0 to 3. Writable only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0; not synchronized.

fields.name: MUXNEG
fields.text: Negative input of comparator n. Writable only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0; not synchronized.

fields.name: INTSEL
fields.text: What makes comparator n raise its interrupt or event: 0x0 output toggle; 0x1 rising output; 0x2 falling output; 0x3 end of comparison, single-shot mode only. Writable only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0; not synchronized.

values.name: EOC
values.text: Interrupt at end of comparison; single-shot mode only.

fields.name: SPEED
fields.text: Speed and propagation delay of comparator n: 0x0 low speed; 0x1 high speed; 0x2-0x3 reserved. Writable only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0; not synchronized.

fields.name: SINGLE
fields.text: Chooses single-shot or continuous operation of comparator n. Writable only while COMPCTRLn.ENABLE is 0; not synchronized.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Writing 1 turns comparator n on, 0 turns it off; the change takes at least two GCLK_AC_DIG cycles to synchronize, the old state reads back until it is done, and while set the other COMPCTRLn bits are locked until a 0 has been written and synchronized.

fields.name: VALUE
fields.text: Scaling factor of channel n of the VDD scaler: VSCALE = VDD x (VALUE + 1) / 64.

fields.name: RUNSTDBY
fields.text: Chooses whether the DAC output buffer may stay on in standby sleep mode. Not synchronized.

values.text: Output buffer may stay on in standby.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Turns the DAC on or off; the written value reads back at once while STATUS.SYNCBUSY is set, and SYNCBUSY clears when the change has taken effect.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: Writing 1 returns every DAC register to its reset value and disables the DAC; it overrides any other write in the same operation, and both SWRST and STATUS.SYNCBUSY clear once the synchronized reset is done. Writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: REFSEL
fields.text: DAC reference: 0x0 INT1V, internal 1.0 V; 0x1 AVCC; 0x2 VREFA, external; 0x3 reserved.

fields.name: BDWP
fields.text: Lifts the Peripheral Access Controller write protection from DATABUF.

fields.name: VPD
fields.text: Turns off the voltage pump.

fields.name: LEFTADJ
fields.text: Sets where the 10-bit value sits in DATA and DATABUF.

fields.name: IOEN
fields.text: Routes the DAC output internally to the AC.

values.text: Internal output on, for the AC.

fields.name: EOEN
fields.text: Drives the DAC output onto the VOUT pin.

fields.name: EMPTYEO
fields.text: Enables the event generated when DATABUF is empty.

fields.name: STARTEI
fields.text: Makes an incoming event load DATABUF into DATA, starting a conversion.

values.text: Events do not start a conversion.
An incoming event starts a conversion.

fields.name: EMPTY
fields.text: Writing 1 disables the Data Buffer Empty interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: EMPTY

fields.text: Writing 1 enables the Underrun interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: SYNCRDY
fields.text: Set when STATUS.SYNCBUSY falls from 1 to 0, except after an enable or software reset, and requests an interrupt if enabled; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: EMPTY
fields.text: Set when DATABUF has moved to DATA and the DAC can take new DATABUF data, requesting an interrupt if EMPTY is enabled; cleared by writing 1 or by writing DATABUF, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: UNDERRUN
fields.text: Set when a start conversion event arrives with DATABUF empty, requesting an interrupt if UNDERRUN is enabled; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: SYNCBUSY
fields.text: Reads 1 while registers are being synchronized between clock domains, 0 once that is done.

fields.name: DATA
fields.text: The 10-bit value the DAC turns into a voltage, in DATA[9:0] when CTRLB.LEFTADJ is 0 or DATA[15:6] when it is 1.

fields.name: DATABUF
fields.text: Value waiting to be moved into DATA, in DATABUF[9:0] when CTRLB.LEFTADJ is 0 or DATABUF[15:6] when it is 1.
